about.title: About Sonary
about.music_more_than_history: Music is more than a listening history
about.intro: Sonary is a music diary designed to preserve not just tracks, but the impressions connected to them.
about.collection: Add music to your collection, rate it, write notes and reviews, record your mood and create playlists. Over time, these entries form a personal history of the music you listened to and what it meant to you.
about.services_remember: Most music services remember what we listen to. Far fewer remember what we thought about it.
about.idea: Sonary began with a simple idea: a place to return to months or years later and see not just a track title, but your own opinion of it at the time.
about.questions: Which song played all summer? Which album grew on you? What did you listen to at a particular time in your life? Sonary is made for these things.
about.project_description: Sonary is an independent passion project. It was not built as a startup or to maximise profit. We do not aim to retain users at any cost, put every feature behind a subscription or fill the interface with ads.
about.project_approach: We want to experiment with design, add interesting features, learn and gradually build a product we would enjoy using. Decisions are guided by what makes Sonary better, not just what is profitable.
about.your_music_text: Everyone has their own relationship with music. Sonary does not tell you what to like. There are no correct ratings or opinions here.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Answers to common questions about Sonary. If your question is missing, we may not have added it yet.
faq.what_is_text: A music diary for saving tracks, rating them, recording impressions, creating playlists and building your own music history.
faq.streaming_text: No. Sonary does not replace Spotify, Apple Music, Yandex Music or other services. Its purpose is to preserve your impressions of music.
faq.free_text: Yes. It is a passion project; core features will be available without a subscription.
faq.reviews_text: You do not need a full review. A thought or impression that you might enjoy revisiting is enough.
faq.playlists_text: Yes. Group saved tracks into themed collections: favourites of the year, music from a period of your life or a particular mood.
faq.mood_title: What does an entry's mood mean?
faq.mood_text: Mood adds context: the same track can be connected to different periods and emotions.
faq.edit_title: Can I edit an entry later?
faq.edit_text: Yes. Your opinion of a track can change — that is normal.
faq.private_playlist_title: Can I make a playlist private?
faq.private_playlist_text: Yes. Private playlists are visible only to their owner.
faq.data_text: We aim to collect only what Sonary needs to function. See the Terms of Use for details.
faq.ads_text: Sonary is not built as an advertising platform. Our goal is to develop the product, not monetise attention.
faq.team_text: An independent project that grows through an interest in music, design and development.
faq.development_text: Yes. Features and the interface may change. Ideas, feedback and bug reports are always welcome.

translation_overrides.agreement.title: Consent to personal data processing
translation_overrides.agreement.intro: I confirm that I have read the information about personal data processing in Sonary and consent to the processing of my data under this document.
translation_overrides.agreement.data_text: Sonary may process email addresses, usernames, display names, profile photos and descriptions, music entries, playlists, ratings and moods, account settings, and technical data required to operate and secure the service.
translation_overrides.agreement.purposes_text: Data is used to create and operate accounts, authenticate users, save preferences, run the music diary, store user content, maintain security, restore access, diagnose errors and improve Sonary.
translation_overrides.agreement.privacy_text: Sonary does not sell personal data or share it with advertisers. Third-party access is limited to what is necessary to operate the service, protect users or comply with the law.
translation_overrides.agreement.public_private_text: Users control the available profile visibility settings. Data marked private is not intended to be displayed to other users.
translation_overrides.agreement.uploads_text: Files may be stored and technically processed as required for the selected features. Sonary does not acquire ownership of user materials.
translation_overrides.agreement.statistics_text: With separate consent, aggregated information about feature usage, errors, device types and performance may be collected.
translation_overrides.agreement.security_text: Sonary takes reasonable safeguards. Data is retained only as long as required for processing purposes, disputes, security and legal obligations.
translation_overrides.agreement.rights_text: Users may request information about processing, correction or deletion, restrictions on processing and withdrawal of consent where provided by law.
translation_overrides.agreement.confirmation_text: By drawing a signature and confirming, the user acknowledges reading and understanding the document and voluntarily agreeing to its terms.
